statuses.live: Running today in the Lucy harness.

categories.name: Essential
categories.tagline: The core every Lucy gets: your chats, email, calendar, reminders, memory and the safety rails.

categories.name: Productivity
categories.tagline: Optional: voice, focus, planning and personal life admin on top of the core.

categories.name: Builder
categories.tagline: Optional: coding agents, background jobs, previews, designs and your own modules.

features.name: Lives in WhatsApp
features.description: Chat with Lucy on her own WhatsApp number, in DMs and groups. Telegram works too.

features.name: Per-chat permissions
features.description: Every chat gets a tier (read, ask, write, admin) so guests can ask questions without changing anything.

features.name: Approve before anything goes out
features.description: Messages, emails and calendar invites are drafted first. Nothing is sent until you say yes.

features.name: Owner passphrase
features.description: Prove it's you from a new number or device with a hashed passphrase.

features.name: Understands voice notes
features.description: Voice notes are transcribed locally and handled like text.

features.name: Long-term memory
features.description: Remembers facts, preferences and promises across chats, and searches the past with dates.

features.name: Listening notes
features.description: In chats you turn on, Lucy keeps running notes: decisions, deadlines, action items and open questions.

features.name: Reminders that ring
features.description: Natural-language reminders ('fri 5pm', '+30m') with nagging, a watchdog and an Apple Reminders mirror so they ring even if Lucy is down.

features.name: Smart follow-ups
features.description: "Ping them Thursday if they haven't replied": only fires when nobody wrote back.

features.name: Promise tracker
features.description: Everything Lucy promised or was asked to do, across every chat, in one task list.

features.name: Calendar
features.description: See your day, find free slots and create events after you confirm the preview.

features.name: Morning digest
features.description: A morning brief of your calendar, reminders and important email.

features.name: Email triage and drafts
features.description: Surfaces the emails that matter and writes replies as drafts in your voice. Never sends on its own.

features.name: Secrets vault
features.description: Passwords go in through a one-time link, never through chat. Lucy can use them without ever seeing them.

features.name: Live dashboard
features.description: A private web dashboard for jobs, reminders, memory and earnings, with 'tell Lucy' built in.

features.name: Kill switch
features.description: Say 'stop everything' and every background agent halts at once.

features.name: Desktop and web app
features.description: A chat app with module panels, for Mac and the browser.

features.name: One-click install
features.description: Download, sign in, link WhatsApp and go. No terminal needed.

features.name: Email & Calendar
features.description: Read your inbox and calendar, write drafts. Nothing is ever sent without your explicit approval.

features.name: Memory
features.description: Long-term notes the assistant can remember, search and forget. Stored locally.

features.name: Reminders
features.description: Local reminders with natural times ('in 2h', 'tomorrow 9am'). Notifications stay on this device.

features.name: Vault
features.description: Encrypted local secret store (AES-256-GCM). Secret values are never returned to chat.

features.name: WhatsApp
features.description: Link your WhatsApp (and optionally a second bot number) by QR or pairing code. Replies are drafts until you approve them.

features.name: Replies with voice
features.description: Optional spoken replies as WhatsApp voice notes, generated on-device for free.

features.name: Smart speaker
features.description: Talk to Lucy and hear answers through an Echo speaker.

features.name: Voice from the dashboard
features.description: Hold to talk in the browser; Lucy answers in your chat and out loud.

features.name: People graph
features.description: A private map of who you know and how they connect, built from your own notes.

features.name: Day planner
features.description: Turn a rough day schedule into calendar blocks and a tracked project board.

features.name: OTP and alert relay
features.description: Forwards one-time codes and urgent alerts from SMS and mail to a private chat.

features.name: Send as you, with approval
features.description: Lucy drafts messages from your own number; you get the exact text and reply 'send' to release it.

features.name: Tunnel Vision
features.description: Commit to 1 to 3 tasks; Lucy holds you to them and blocks distracting Mac apps until you're done.

features.name: Leisure breaks
features.description: Take a real break: Lucy holds new work until you're back.

features.name: Activity log
features.description: A private movement log, with steps and active calories synced from your watch.

features.name: Apple Watch app
features.description: A small watch app that syncs activity to Lucy.

features.name: Mac control app
features.description: A native Mac app to see and steer Lucy from the menu bar.

features.name: Canvas Learning
features.description: Read-only Canvas LMS: courses, assignments, grades, deadlines and a study planner.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Timed focus sessions with a log, and an end-of-session reminder.

features.name: Client-friendly groups
features.description: In client chats Lucy answers status questions in plain English, with no internals.

features.name: Bring your own engine
features.description: Run work on Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Cursor, switchable per chat or per job.

features.name: Coding pipeline
features.description: Describe a change; Lucy plans it, splits it across parallel agents on their own branches, reviews and opens a pull request.

features.name: Background jobs
features.description: Long tasks run in the background and report back to the chat when done, so the conversation stays free.

features.name: Work pool autopilot
features.description: A prioritised backlog that keeps a capped number of jobs running, balancing engines automatically.

features.name: Previews and prototypes
features.description: Spin up preview links and quick prototypes to show work in progress.

features.name: Many parallel sessions
features.description: Separate sessions per project and chat that can ask, hand off to and report to each other.

features.name: Mini pages
features.description: Long answers become clean mobile pages instead of walls of text in chat.

features.name: Uses your browser
features.description: Can drive your logged-in Chrome for web tasks, and join a video call muted to take notes.

features.name: Connectors
features.description: Works with Gmail, Drive, Figma, Canva, Vercel, Supabase and more through standard connectors.

features.name: Designs and decks
features.description: Ask for a mockup, poster or slide deck and get an editable link back in chat.

features.name: Build your own Lucy
features.description: Pick what you want Lucy for, and the app assembles itself with only those modules.

features.name: Module catalog
features.description: Browse and add community modules to your Lucy.

features.name: Hosted Lucy
features.description: Run Lucy in the cloud instead of on your own Mac.

features.name: Coding
features.description: Plan coding tasks, run parallel agent sessions in git worktrees, and open PRs after approval. Never merges.
